name: D3 Floorspec for Claude
description: Claude's connector to D3 Floorspec's MCP server (https://floorspec.d3cloud.io/mcp). A public client: PKCE and no secret, because the connector sends client_secret_post, which D3 Auth does not accept. Its access tokens are minted for the resource https://floorspec.d3cloud.io/mcp, and D3 Floorspec treats them as an agent: changesets, never the plan itself.

roles.description: Reads the person's own projects and proposes changesets; D3 Floorspec has no roles yet.
